data.name: Shubham
data.gender_notes: Shubham is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śubha, 'auspicious, good, beautiful'. Its root is Sanskrit śubha (शुभ). A classical Sanskrit term for auspiciousness. Shubham is a Sanskrit name meaning “Auspicious; fortunate; good”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shubham expresses “Auspicious; fortunate; good”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit śubha, 'auspicious, good, beautiful'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shubham total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

faq.q: What is the historical or scriptural reference for Shubham?
faq.a: A classical Sanskrit term for auspiciousness.

faq.q: What is the lucky number for Shubham?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Shubham is 9 (ruling planet Mars). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Shubham?
faq.a: Tuesday is the traditional association for Shubham. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Shubham?
faq.a: Red Coral is the traditional association for Shubham. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Shubham?
faq.a: Red, Crimson are the traditional associations for Shubham. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of Shubham?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shubham total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

faq.a: The meaning of Shubham carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.a: Shubham is recorded as a hindu name meaning “Auspicious; fortunate; good”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Shubham?
faq.a: In English, Shubham is rendered as “Auspicious; fortunate; good”.

faq.q: Is Shubham suitable for a baby?
faq.a: Shubham is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.
